question: How can the luminous reality ever be without reflective awareness?
premises: The nature of the luminous reality is to shine.
A shining reality cannot be unexamined by awareness.
By sovereign free will, even the most difficult becomes possible.
inference: Because of its luminous nature and sovereign freedom, the reality is never truly devoid of awareness.
plain_english: How could any form of that whose nature is to shine ever remain unexamined by awareness? Therefore, by the power of its sovereign free will, this reality accomplishes even what seems most difficult.
